fixed.summary: Dev builds are named dev.<YYYYMMDD>.<n> (the n-th of that UTC day), a number unrelated to the release numbers; their manifest.json and build record name the release they are based on (base) and their exact revision. The og launcher installs, lists and prunes them (a dev build orders after its base release and before the next), latest/ never names one, and og new without --engine takes the latest release. Dev builds of the old x.y.z-dev.n scheme (0.8.1-dev.100) stay installable.

og upgrade moves a release pin onto a dev build only when --to names it, then crosses the dev build's own unreleased changes, and never treats a dev build as newer than a release by its numbers. og doctor and the pin warning compare a dev pin as the release it is based on. og --version of a dev build names its base release.
